candidate_classes.exactness: intended exact hot/cold split, but still requires top1 verifier before performance
candidate_classes.host_ram_impact: no model run; H0 bound only
candidate_classes.name: current_ds4_hot_dispatch
candidate_classes.reason: Preserving accepted gate cache leaves only about 238 MiB; best partial hot dispatch within that budget saves negligible CPU rows. Full-layer k values need 4.1-11.7 GiB and still have optimistic no-overhead ceilings around the current SOTA to about 5 tok/s while requiring severe gate-cache reduction. This cannot plausibly move toward 10 tok/s and should be rejected before verifier/performance runs.
candidate_classes.vram_cost: best preserving accepted gate cache: 191.25 MiB used under 238 MiB free

candidate_classes.exactness: exact only for rows already pruned by current keep_topk policy
candidate_classes.name: true_skip_zero_row
candidate_classes.reason: There are no remaining exact pruned rows to skip in the CPU fallback loop; pruned rows are already zeroed before fallback. The only exact skip/zero saving is the historical grouping/zero-fill cost around 82 ms. Skipping more rows would be approximate top-k pruning, and the relevant top2 variants already failed trajectory/correctness or performance.

evidence: hot64 measured 3.6 tok/s with manual semantic failure
nofilter measured 1.8 tok/s with incomplete generation
candidate_classes.exactness: can change generation trajectory; must pass full-output/top1 correctness
candidate_classes.host_ram_impact: strict cold runs stayed within 16GB but refault/cache counters worsened
candidate_classes.name: existing_one_stream_gpu_updown_cache_classes
candidate_classes.reason: No already-tested GPU up/down class is worth another run. The next run would need a new deterministic correctness mechanism and hard-bound design, not a larger hotset sweep.
candidate_classes.vram_cost: uses same VRAM pressure class as gate cache and can collapse cache/source behavior

evidence: trace_sum_ms/20 is close to stderr fallback wall estimate, leaving only about 1-2s attributable to non-chunk overhead/tail at this granularity
per-thread total spread is about 2.94s across the whole run, not enough to explain the gap to 10 tok/s
top tensors are early-layer up/down experts, matching CPU fallback compute/source pressure rather than gate cache failure
gate pack and VRAM cache counters remain healthy; RAM and correctness pass
chunk_trace_conclusion.next_recommendation: do not repeat chunk-size or affinity probes; use lower-overhead dot/page split evidence or move to algorithmic correctness-preserving speculation/offload only with a clear >1-2s bound
chunk_trace_conclusion.primary: chunk scheduling is not the dominant bottleneck under current 4.4 tok/s SOTA config

current_bottleneck.primary: up/down CPU fallback, especially early layers and prompt-phase fallback

all_decode_updown_and_one_stream_source_.candidate: all CPU up/down decode fallback + all one-stream source time removed
all_decode_updown_and_one_stream_source_.caveat: not a single feasible implementation; shows 10 tok/s needs stacked wins or speculation
all_decode_updown_and_one_stream_source_.required_extra: requires eliminating CPU fallback plus gate source stalls

all_decode_updown_removed.caveat: ideal upper bound; still below 10 tok/s by itself
all_decode_updown_removed.required_extra: ~22.3 GiB unique decode payload if naively resident

all_remaining_updown_fallback_reference.verdict: large enough, but this requires exact compute/offload/layout work, not skip/zero pruning

next_required_work: Inspect the active CPU fallback code path to identify a new exact mechanism that reduces actual up/down source/dot work instead of only changing scheduling.
A viable design must explain how it avoids the rejected hot-dispatch VRAM/gate-cache tradeoff and rejected repack/page-refault regressions.
If the design can change logits, run the lightweight top1 verifier before any strict cold token-rate run.
screening_result.verdict: No already-defined concrete runtime candidate passes the plan's screening gate. Do not run another full model benchmark until a new exact compute/offload/layout mechanism has a hard bound above tie and a correctness-verification path.
